name: WUOZ Connect
author: Wuoz

sections.description:
WUOZ Connect is a plugin that connects your WooCommerce store with the WUOZ platform, enabling powerful marketing automation, advanced analytics, and seamless integration with Meta Ads.

Key Features:

  • Automatic Contact Import: Sync customers and segments from your store to Wuoz for targeted campaigns.
  • Emails with Dynamic Products: Send personalized recommendations based on shopping behavior.
  • Powerful Automations: Recover abandoned carts, send welcome emails, follow-ups, and much more.
  • Advanced Analytics (WZTM): Track the complete customer journey, from email click to purchase.
  • Meta Campaigns Integration: Connect your store and launch Meta Ads campaigns directly from Wuoz.
  • Smart Popups & Banners: Create and publish lead-capture popups and promotional banners on your site.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its core functionality.

WUOZ Platform API (wuoz.it / app.wuoz.it)

The plugin communicates with the WUOZ platform to validate the connection, sync marketing content (snippets/popups), and send tracking/automation events needed to run campaigns.

Data sent can include:
* Site URL and basic site metadata (during connection and sync operations)
* WooCommerce customer identifiers (e.g., user ID/email) and cart/product identifiers (when enabled features are used)
* Event metadata (page URL, timestamps, UTM parameters, and similar analytics fields)

When data is sent:
* During connection/disconnection actions in the plugin settings
* During scheduled/background sync (e.g., abandoned cart sync)
* When snippets/tracking features are enabled and the related events occur

Service provider: WUOZ (https://wuoz.it)
Terms of Service: https://wuoz.it/en/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://wuoz.it/en/privacy-policy

You can opt out by disconnecting the store in the plugin settings and/or disabling tracking options in the plugin settings.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following third-party libraries (GPL-compatible licenses):

  • Tailwind CSS – MIT License. License text: licenses/TailwindCSS-LICENSE.txt
  • Lucide – ISC License. License text: licenses/Lucide-LICENSE.txt
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wuoz-connect directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Wuoz Settings’ page to connect your store.
sections.faq:
Do I need a WUOZ account?

Yes, you need a WUOZ account to use the features provided by this plugin.
